description: This file implements functions related to initializing and clearing a Lua state within the lighttpd server, including conditional compilation based on the presence of Lua headers.

methods.name: void li_lua_init(liLuaState * LL,liServer * srv,liWorker * wrk)
methods.description: Initializes a new Lua state, sets up its registry, loads standard libraries, and performs additional initialization via li_lua_init2.

methods.name: void li_lua_clear(liLuaState * LL)
methods.description: Closes the Lua state and frees associated resources.

ctags.name: li_lua_init
ctags.pattern: /^void li_lua_init(liLuaState* LL, liServer* srv, liWorker* wrk) {$/
